# Kern

> Kern UI by Xoroh — an open-source design system following Material
> Design 3. One contract, web and native. Full docs: /docs

## AI agents

Prefer these machine surfaces over scraping HTML:
- /llms.txt (this file) — the complete page map, generated from the nav, the content docs and the foundations registry
- Per-page markdown at /md/{web|mobile}/<slug>.md and /md/foundations/<slug>.md — same content the page renders, linked from every component and Foundations page via its View .md affordance
- /mcp/index.json — the whole docs corpus as data: title, one-liner, page route, and .md URL per page
- Copy as Markdown button on every component and Foundations page — page prose + code + links, live-demo controls excluded
- Agent skills in the repo: .agents/skills/kern/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/kern-agents/SKILL.md and .agents/skills/docs/SKILL.md (https://github.com/xoroh/kern/tree/main/.agents/skills)

## Overview

- [Design systems](/foundations): The systems kern documents — M3 today, shaped for more

## Material 3

- [Material 3](/foundations/m3): The current system — tokens, theme, and the layer beneath
- [Tokens](/foundations/m3/tokens): The token architecture — naming, roles, bands
- [Color](/foundations/m3/color): M3 role system, pairing law, usage rules
- [Typography](/foundations/m3/type): M3 type scale, specimens, roles
- [Shape](/foundations/m3/shape): M3 corner scale and shape ladder
- [Elevation](/foundations/m3/elevation): M3 levels, shadows, surface depth
- [Motion](/foundations/m3/motion): Easing, durations, springs
- [States](/foundations/m3/states): State layers, interaction states, focus
- [Theme](/foundations/m3/theme): M3 color roles in the active theme

## Primitives

- [Primitives](/primitives): Headless behavior kernel for web and native
- [useControllableState](/primitives/use-controllable-state): One state hook for controlled/uncontrolled components
- [Dismiss policy](/primitives/dismiss-policy): One dismissal rule for escape / outside-press / pointer-down
- [Dismiss wiring](/primitives/dismiss-wiring): Wiring helpers that connect dismiss sources to the dismissal policy
- [Focus trap](/primitives/focus-trap): Focus-trap model: tab cycling bounds and autofocus resolution
- [Overlay modality](/primitives/overlay-modality): Tracks which overlay layer owns the keyboard and screen-reader focus
- [Portal](/primitives/portal): Portal registry and target resolution
- [Positioning](/primitives/positioning): Floating-position math: origin, rect, viewport clamping
- [Presence](/primitives/presence): Mount/unmount presence states
- [Press](/primitives/press): Press phases and activation keys
- [Roving focus](/primitives/roving): Roving-tabindex keyboard focus for toolbars, tabs, menus
- [Selection](/primitives/selection): Selection helpers shared by both renderers
- [Slot](/primitives/slot): Slot prop merging and handler composition
- [Time](/primitives/time): Time-value formatting and normalization
- [A11y helpers](/primitives/a11y): Id scopes, direction resolution, visually-hidden styles

## Foundations pages (Material 3)

- [Tokens](/foundations/m3/tokens): The named values everything else is built from.
- [Color](/foundations/m3/color): Roles are decisions, not colours — and kern ships more of them than Material 3 does.
- [Typography](/foundations/m3/type): Thirty styles, each rendered by its own tokens.
- [Shape](/foundations/m3/shape): The corner scale, including Material 3's Expressive additions.
- [Elevation](/foundations/m3/elevation): Six levels, and which components rest at which.
- [Motion](/foundations/m3/motion): Spring first, easing as the fallback.
- [States](/foundations/m3/states): What happens to a surface when it is hovered, pressed, dragged or disabled.

## Component families (M3)

- [Accordion](/components/m3/accordion): Accordions stack collapsible sections, so a long page can be scanned as headings first. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/accordion.md, /md/mobile/accordion.md.
- [Action sheet](/components/m3/action-sheet): The action sheet is a titled list of actions in a bottom sheet — the one surface for "what do you want to do with this?" Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/action-sheet.md, /md/mobile/action-sheet.md.
- [Alert dialog](/components/m3/alert-dialog): Alert dialogs interrupt for a decision that must be made before anything else continues. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/alert-dialog.md, /md/mobile/alert-dialog.md.
- [App shell](/components/m3/app-shell): The app shell is the frame around everything else — top bar, rail, drawer, status bar — with every region optional. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/app-shell.md, /md/mobile/app-shell.md.
- [Aspect ratio](/components/m3/aspect-ratio): Aspect ratio boxes keep a fixed width-to-height ratio, whatever width they are given. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/aspect-ratio.md.
- [Autocomplete](/components/m3/autocomplete): Autocompletes suggest values as someone types, and fill in the one they mean. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/autocomplete.md, /md/mobile/autocomplete.md.
- [Avatar](/components/m3/avatar): Avatars show who something belongs to, as an image or as initials. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/avatar.md, /md/mobile/avatar.md.
- [Badge](/components/m3/badge): Badges flag a small, countable change on something that already has a label. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/badge.md, /md/mobile/badge.md.
- [Banner](/components/m3/banner): Banners report something the whole screen needs to know, without blocking what people are doing. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/banner.md, /md/mobile/banner.md.
- [Boot indicator](/components/m3/boot-indicator): Boot indicators are the branded loading surface shown while the app itself starts. Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/boot-indicator.md.
- [Boot splash](/components/m3/boot-splash): Boot splashes cover the first moment of an app, with your mark and optional milestone steps. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/boot-splash.md.
- [Bottom sheet](/components/m3/bottom-sheet): The bottom sheet is a modal surface anchored to the bottom edge: content, an optional heading and a visible way out. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/bottom-sheet.md, /md/mobile/bottom-sheet.md.
- [Bottom sheet picker](/components/m3/bottom-sheet-picker): The bottom sheet picker is a selector in a sheet — a titled list of options where the selection is announced, not just tinted. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/bottom-sheet-picker.md, /md/mobile/bottom-sheet-picker.md.
- [Button](/components/m3/button): Buttons let people carry out an action with a single tap, click or key press. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/button.md, /md/mobile/button.md.
- [Button group](/components/m3/button-group): Button groups join buttons into one segmented control. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/button-group.md, /md/mobile/button-group.md.
- [Calendar](/components/m3/calendar): Calendars pick a single date from a month grid. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/calendar.md, /md/mobile/calendar.md.
- [Card](/components/m3/card): Cards group related content and actions into a single surface. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/card.md, /md/mobile/card.md.
- [Carousel](/components/m3/carousel): Carousels show one slide at a time from a set, moved through with controls or by gesture. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/carousel.md, /md/mobile/carousel.md.
- [Checkbox](/components/m3/checkbox): Checkboxes let people pick several things from a set, or agree to something one at a time. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/checkbox.md, /md/mobile/checkbox.md.
- [Checkbox group](/components/m3/checkbox-group): A checkbox group collects several independent choices into one value you can read at once. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/checkbox-group.md, /md/mobile/checkbox-group.md.
- [Chip](/components/m3/chip): Chips are compact elements that represent an attribute, an action, or a filter. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/chip.md, /md/mobile/chip.md.
- [Circular progress](/components/m3/circular-progress): Circular progress shows how much of a task is done, as a ring. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/circular-progress.md, /md/mobile/circular-progress.md.
- [Collapsible](/components/m3/collapsible): Collapsibles hide a section of content behind a trigger and show it on demand. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/collapsible.md, /md/mobile/collapsible.md.
- [Combobox](/components/m3/combobox): Comboboxes pick one value from a set, either from the list or by typing to narrow it. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/combobox.md, /md/mobile/combobox.md.
- [Command](/components/m3/command): Commands are searchable lists of actions and destinations, filtered as you type. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/command.md, /md/mobile/command.md.
- [Context menu](/components/m3/context-menu): Context menus offer the actions for a thing where the thing is, opened by right-clicking it. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/context-menu.md, /md/mobile/context-menu.md.
- [ContrastToggle](/components/m3/contrast-toggle): One action that requests a contrast change, named for where the press goes rather than where it is. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/contrast-toggle.md.
- [Country select](/components/m3/country-select): Country selects pick a country from a list, showing its flag and dial code alongside its name. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/country-select.md, /md/mobile/country-select.md.
- [Dialog](/components/m3/dialog): A dialog asks people to complete a focused task before they carry on with the rest of the app. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/dialog.md, /md/mobile/dialog.md.
- [Dock sheet](/components/m3/dock-sheet): The dock sheet is a persistent quick-action bar peeking from the bottom edge — a region, not a dialog. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/dock-sheet.md, /md/mobile/dock-sheet.md.
- [Drawer](/components/m3/drawer): A drawer is a panel that slides up from the bottom edge for a short, self-contained step. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/drawer.md, /md/mobile/drawer.md.
- [Empty state](/components/m3/empty-state): Empty states say what is missing, and offer the one thing that would fix it. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/empty-state.md, /md/mobile/empty-state.md.
- [Entity sheet](/components/m3/entity-sheet): The entity sheet is the read-mostly detail surface for one record — a title, its fields, and at most one action. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/entity-sheet.md, /md/mobile/entity-sheet.md.
- [Error boundary](/components/m3/error-boundary): Error boundaries catch a thrown render so one broken screen does not blank the whole app. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/error-boundary.md.
- [Extended FAB](/components/m3/extended-fab): Extended FABs are the labelled floating action button — the one primary action, with its name beside its icon. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/extended-fab.md, /md/mobile/extended-fab.md.
- [Floating action button](/components/m3/fab): The floating action button is the single most important action on a screen. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/fab.md, /md/mobile/fab.md.
- [FAB menu](/components/m3/fab-menu): FAB menus hold several related actions behind one floating button, opened on tap. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/fab-menu.md, /md/mobile/fab-menu.md.
- [Field](/components/m3/field): A field pairs a control with its label, its help text and its error, and wires them together. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/field.md, /md/mobile/field.md.
- [Fieldset](/components/m3/fieldset): Fieldsets group related controls under one legend and give them a shared disabled state. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/fieldset.md, /md/mobile/fieldset.md.
- [Filter chip row](/components/m3/filter-chip-row): The filter chip row is a horizontal row of multi-select toggles — press once to apply a filter, press again to remove it. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/filter-chip-row.md, /md/mobile/filter-chip-row.md.
- [Focus ring](/components/m3/focus-ring): Focus rings paint the visible keyboard-focus treatment on host content. Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/focus-ring.md.
- [Form](/components/m3/form): Forms collect several values and hand them over together. Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/form.md.
- [Hero](/components/m3/hero): Hero opens a page with its main heading, supporting copy, actions, and optional art. Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/hero.md.
- [Icon button](/components/m3/icon-button): Icon buttons are buttons whose content is a single glyph. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/icon-button.md, /md/mobile/icon-button.md.
- [Icon button target](/components/m3/icon-button-target): Icon button targets are the touch-target wrapper that brings a small button up to the platform minimum. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/icon-button-target.md.
- [Input](/components/m3/input): Inputs take a single line of text from someone and hand it to you. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/input.md, /md/mobile/input.md.
- [Input OTP](/components/m3/input-otp): OTP inputs take a short numeric code one character at a time, as it is typed. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/input-otp.md, /md/mobile/input-otp.md.
- [Kbd](/components/m3/kbd): Kbds show a keyboard key or shortcut as text, in the shape of a key. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/kbd.md, /md/mobile/kbd.md.
- [Kern error boundary](/components/m3/kern-error-boundary): The kern error boundary catches a thrown render, shows your fallback with a working reset, and never reloads the page to recover. Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/kern-error-boundary.md.
- [Kern pressable](/components/m3/kern-pressable): The narrow accessibility-defaults wrap for anything pressable on native: Material's minimum touch target, a button role by default, and `disabled` always reported. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/kern-pressable.md.
- [Label](/components/m3/label): Labels name the control they sit beside. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/label.md, /md/mobile/label.md.
- [Linear progress](/components/m3/linear-progress): Linear progress shows how much of a task is done, as a bar across a width. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/linear-progress.md, /md/mobile/linear-progress.md.
- [Link](/components/m3/link): Links are anchors that can be pointed at your host router, so kern never hardcodes one. Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/link.md.
- [Link button](/components/m3/link-button): Link buttons wear the button treatment on a navigation control — an anchor, not an action. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/link-button.md, /md/mobile/link-button.md.
- [List detail](/components/m3/list-detail): List detail is the phone-width master–detail pattern: the list until an item is selected, then the detail with a way back. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/list-detail.md.
- [List item](/components/m3/list-item): List items are rows in a list — a headline, optional supporting text, and optional leading and trailing slots. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/list-item.md, /md/mobile/list-item.md.
- [Loader](/components/m3/loader): Loaders say something is happening, in the space where it is happening. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/loader.md, /md/mobile/loader.md.
- [Loading button](/components/m3/loading-button): Loading buttons show that the action they trigger is still running, without changing size. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/loading-button.md, /md/mobile/loading-button.md.
- [Loading indicator](/components/m3/loading-indicator): Loading indicators are the labelled spinner — a wait with its name attached. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/loading-indicator.md, /md/mobile/loading-indicator.md.
- [Loading region](/components/m3/loading-region): Loading regions swap between content and a loading state as work starts and finishes. Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/loading-region.md.
- [Menu](/components/m3/menu): Menus list the actions available on something, opened from the control that owns them. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/menu.md, /md/mobile/menu.md.
- [Menu group list](/components/m3/menu-group-list): Menu group lists render groups of actions under their headings — the shared list the menu screens and sheets are both built from. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/menu-group-list.md.
- [Menu screen](/components/m3/menu-screen): The menu screen is a full-height list of grouped destinations and actions — a settings-style page, not a menu. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/menu-screen.md, /md/mobile/menu-screen.md.
- [Menu sheet](/components/m3/menu-sheet): The menu sheet hosts a grouped action menu in a bottom sheet — the same menu data as the menu screen, with a dismissal path around it. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/menu-sheet.md, /md/mobile/menu-sheet.md.
- [Menubar](/components/m3/menubar): A menubar is a horizontal row of menus, the way an application exposes its commands. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/menubar.md, /md/mobile/menubar.md.
- [Meter](/components/m3/meter): Meters show a value against a range, so a quantity can be read at a glance. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/meter.md, /md/mobile/meter.md.
- [Milestone trio](/components/m3/milestone-trio): Milestone trios show where someone is in a short sequence — done, current, and what is left. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/milestone-trio.md.
- [Native select](/components/m3/native-select): Native selects are the browser's own dropdown, styled to sit with the rest of a form. Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/native-select.md.
- [Navigation bar](/components/m3/navigation-bar): The navigation bar is the compact-screen destination switcher that sits along the bottom edge. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/navigation-bar.md, /md/mobile/navigation-bar.md.
- [Navigation bar item](/components/m3/navigation-bar-item): Navigation bar items are one destination row for vertical containers — a drawer, a rail or a sidebar list. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/navigation-bar-item.md.
- [Navigation drawer](/components/m3/navigation-drawer): The navigation drawer is the modal panel that lists an app's top-level destinations on larger screens. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/navigation-drawer.md, /md/mobile/navigation-drawer.md.
- [Navigation menu](/components/m3/navigation-menu): Navigation menus open a panel of links from a trigger in a site's main navigation. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/navigation-menu.md, /md/mobile/navigation-menu.md.
- [Navigation rail](/components/m3/navigation-rail): The navigation rail is the persistent vertical navigation surface — icon-only by default, a labelled sidebar when expanded. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/navigation-rail.md.
- [Number field](/components/m3/number-field): Number fields take a number from someone, with steppers to nudge it up and down. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/number-field.md, /md/mobile/number-field.md.
- [Page loader](/components/m3/page-loader): Page loaders are the centred loading surface for a region that is still coming. Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/page-loader.md.
- [Pagination](/components/m3/pagination): Pagination moves through a long set of results one page at a time. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/pagination.md, /md/mobile/pagination.md.
- [Pane](/components/m3/pane): Panes are content regions on a width scale, and the layout shapes built from them — a page, a split, a list-and-detail. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/pane.md, /md/mobile/pane.md.
- [Popover](/components/m3/popover): Popovers surface a small panel of content or controls next to whatever opened them. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/popover.md, /md/mobile/popover.md.
- [Preview card](/components/m3/preview-card): Preview cards show a richer look at a link's destination before anyone commits to going there. Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/preview-card.md.
- [Progress](/components/m3/progress): Progress indicators show how much of something is done while it is still running. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/progress.md, /md/mobile/progress.md.
- [Radio group](/components/m3/radio-group): Radio groups let people pick exactly one option from a set they can see all at once. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/radio-group.md, /md/mobile/radio-group.md.
- [Rich tooltip](/components/m3/rich-tooltip): A tooltip with a subhead, supporting text, and plain-text actions for explanations that need more than a label. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/rich-tooltip.md, /md/mobile/rich-tooltip.md.
- [Scroll area](/components/m3/scroll-area): Scroll areas give a fixed region its own scrollbar, so the page does not scroll away from under the content. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/scroll-area.md, /md/mobile/scroll-area.md.
- [Search](/components/m3/search): Search is a labelled field with submit and clear, for finding things by text. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/search.md, /md/mobile/search.md.
- [Blocks](/components/m3/search-bar): Blocks are the small shell pieces — a search bar, a settings row, a status bar, and the theme and contrast toggles. Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/search-bar.md.
- [Secondary tabs](/components/m3/secondary-tabs): Secondary tabs switch between related views in the middle of a page, below the primary navigation. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/secondary-tabs.md, /md/mobile/secondary-tabs.md.
- [Segmented button](/components/m3/segmented-button): Segmented buttons show a small set of options side by side, with the chosen one visibly selected. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/segmented-button.md, /md/mobile/segmented-button.md.
- [Select](/components/m3/select): Selects let someone choose one value from a set too long to show on the page. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/select.md, /md/mobile/select.md.
- [Select group](/components/m3/select-group): Select groups collect related options under one label inside the open list. Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/select-group.md.
- [Separator](/components/m3/separator): Separators divide one region of content from the next. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/separator.md, /md/mobile/separator.md.
- [Settings row](/components/m3/settings-row): Settings rows pair a label and supporting text with the control that owns them. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/settings-row.md.
- [Shape](/components/m3/shape): Shapes are the six basic forms in the kern radius language, drawn from the shape scale rather than freehand. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/shape.md.
- [Shape art](/components/m3/shape-art): Shape art composes kern shapes into a decorative arrangement — scatter, stack or arch. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/shape-art.md.
- [Sheet](/components/m3/sheet): Sheets slide in from the side to hold a focused task beside the content behind them. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/sheet.md, /md/mobile/sheet.md.
- [Sheet handle](/components/m3/sheet-handle): Sheet handles are the small drag affordance drawn at the top of a sheet. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/sheet-handle.md.
- [Sheet surface](/components/m3/sheet-surface): Sheet surface is the shared modal and scrim shell — the one place a kern sheet gets its dismissal path. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/sheet-surface.md, /md/mobile/sheet-surface.md.
- [Sidebar](/components/m3/sidebar): Sidebars are the app's persistent navigation region, composed from a provider, sections and items. Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/sidebar.md.
- [SiteFooter](/components/m3/site-footer): SiteFooter closes a site page with a brand summary, grouped navigation, and optional legal content. Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/site-footer.md.
- [Skeleton](/components/m3/skeleton): Skeletons stand in for content that is still loading, in the shape it will have. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/skeleton.md, /md/mobile/skeleton.md.
- [Slider](/components/m3/slider): Sliders pick a value from a range by feel, showing where it sits along the way. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/slider.md, /md/mobile/slider.md.
- [Snackbar](/components/m3/snackbar): Snackbars confirm something happened, briefly, without interrupting what someone is doing. Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/snackbar.md.
- [Snackbar](/components/m3/snackbar-provider): Snackbars confirm something happened, briefly, with an optional action to undo it. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/snackbar-provider.md.
- [Snap sheet](/components/m3/snap-sheet): The snap sheet is a bottom sheet with detents — a modal surface that occupies one of a declared set of heights. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/snap-sheet.md, /md/mobile/snap-sheet.md.
- [Split](/components/m3/split): The split is an N-column layout: two or three equal columns divided by a hairline, named as one region for assistive technology. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/split.md, /md/mobile/split.md.
- [Split button](/components/m3/split-button): Split buttons pair one primary action with a menu of related alternatives. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/split-button.md, /md/mobile/split-button.md.
- [Status bar](/components/m3/status-bar): Status bars hold one centered status with leading and trailing slots. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/status-bar.md.
- [Success transform](/components/m3/success-transform): Success transforms are the completion moment — a disc and a tick, or the loader that precedes it. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/success-transform.md.
- [Supporting pane](/components/m3/supporting-pane): Supporting panes hold the secondary panel beside main content, and hide it entirely on a compact screen. Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/supporting-pane.md.
- [Switch](/components/m3/switch): A switch turns a single setting on or off and applies it at once. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/switch.md, /md/mobile/switch.md.
- [Table](/components/m3/table): Tables lay out rows of related values so they can be compared down a column. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/table.md, /md/mobile/table.md.
- [Tabs](/components/m3/tabs): Tabs switch between related views of the same subject without leaving the page. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/tabs.md, /md/mobile/tabs.md.
- [Text](/components/m3/text): Text renders a line of type at one of the typescale's styles. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/text.md, /md/mobile/text.md.
- [Textarea](/components/m3/textarea): Textareas take several lines of text from someone and hand it to you. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/textarea.md, /md/mobile/textarea.md.
- [ThemeToggle](/components/m3/theme-toggle): One action that switches the color scheme between light and dark. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/theme-toggle.md, /md/mobile/theme-toggle.md.
- [Time picker](/components/m3/time-picker): Time pickers set a time of day with explicit hour and minute fields. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/time-picker.md, /md/mobile/time-picker.md.
- [Toggle](/components/m3/toggle): Toggles are buttons that stay pressed, for a setting you switch on and off. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/toggle.md, /md/mobile/toggle.md.
- [Toggle group](/components/m3/toggle-group): Toggle groups hold related toggles together as one control, picking either one option or several. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/toggle-group.md, /md/mobile/toggle-group.md.
- [Toolbar](/components/m3/toolbar): Toolbars hold the controls that act on the content below them. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/toolbar.md, /md/mobile/toolbar.md.
- [Tooltip](/components/m3/tooltip): Tooltips name or explain a control the moment someone hovers or focuses it. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/tooltip.md, /md/mobile/tooltip.md.
- [Top app bar](/components/m3/top-app-bar): The top app bar is the screen's header — leading slot, title, trailing actions — plus the app-level bar and its menus. Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/top-app-bar.md, /md/mobile/top-app-bar.md.
- [TopBar](/components/m3/top-bar): TopBar is a responsive site header with a brand link, primary navigation, and an actions slot. Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/top-bar.md.
